game.title: Vaquejada Voxel
game.description:
Vaquejada Voxel is a Portuguese-language browser game based on Brazilian vaquejada. Its browser interface presents a horse-and-cattle arena, a choice of bull categories, and on-screen riding actions.

The developer’s itch page has no written gameplay description. These details come from the publicly served game interface; a full playthrough has not been performed.
game.how_to_play: Choose a bull category and use the on-screen prompt to release it into the arena. Use the riding controls and follow the available action prompts.
game.controls:
On-screen joystick and buttons — steer and perform riding actions
Use the labeled run and brake controls.
game.tips:
Review the Portuguese button labels before releasing the bull.
Start with the Aspirante category to learn the interface.
game.features:
Voxel-style arena
Horse-and-cattle theme
Portuguese interface
On-screen riding controls
Bull category selection
game.short_description: Ride through a voxel-style vaquejada arena with touch-friendly controls.

game.title: 링 오브 리더즈 (Ring of Leaders)
game.description:
Ring of Leaders is a free, unofficial Pokémon fan game inspired by expedition RPGs such as Darkest Dungeon. Choose six companions from 27 starters, then arrange four combatants in a line with tank, damage and support roles. Tension and lasting quirks make recovery between expeditions part of managing the team.

The early-access game includes 16 main dungeons, themed dungeons, leader skills, Mega Evolution and Dynamax. Town facilities support healing, recruitment and other preparations. English and Korean interfaces support desktop and portrait mobile play. This non-profit project is not affiliated with Nintendo, Creatures or GAME FREAK.
game.how_to_play: Choose companions, assign roles and a four-character formation, then enter a dungeon. Return to town to rest and address expedition consequences before setting out again.
game.controls: Touch input is supported on mobile; use the on-screen interface.
game.tips:
Account for tension when preparing another expedition.
Use Move save in Settings when changing devices; saves otherwise remain in the current browser.
game.features:
16 main dungeons and themed expeditions
Pokémon through Generation 9
Four-position formations and role necklaces
Town management
English and Korean
Browser save transfer
game.short_description: Lead a Pokémon expedition through tense dungeon battles and recover in town.

game.title: TL;DR
game.description:
TL;DR is an incremental typing demo where completed words earn gold for upgrades. There is no timer: progress follows your keystrokes. Pages you finish become movable upgrade boosts, while keyboard countdowns, typing monkeys and overdrive help fill the text.

This free demo contains the tutorial and the complete first chapter of Moby-Dick, roughly an hour according to the developer. It ends at the chapter and can be replayed. The rest of the novel and additional books belong to the planned full version, not this browser demo. Saves are automatic.
game.how_to_play: Follow the cursor and type words to earn gold. Unlock the shop and invest in upgrades, assign completed-page boosts, and combine keyboard credits, monkeys and overdrive to automate more of each page.
game.controls:
Keyboard — type characters
Ctrl — skip an unrecognized character
Tab — switch between the last two tabs
Hold and release the overdrive button — charge and fire
Escape — settings or quit
Mouse wheel — scroll text
game.tips:
Move page boosts between upgrades as your priorities change.
Use Ctrl when a character cannot be entered with your keyboard.
game.features:
First chapter of Moby-Dick
No timer
Typing upgrades and movable page boosts
Keyboard countdown, monkeys and overdrive
Automatic saving
game.short_description: Turn typing the opening chapter of Moby-Dick into an increasingly automated machine.

game.title: Rooklite
game.description:
Rooklite combines chess encounters with a roguelite route. Your knight travels across a board whose road crumbles behind it; entering a rival camp zooms into a smaller battlefield. An army assembled like a deck provides three drawn pieces plus your king, so each encounter starts with a different position.

Battles begin with 30 seconds and gain two seconds per move. Checkmate is required to win, and running out of time ends the run. This free demo covers Tide, the complete first world and its boss. The additional three worlds and special kings are planned for the full game.
game.how_to_play: Choose a forward route through encounters, read the pieces drawn for each battle, and seek checkmate before the clock expires. Recruit and improve pieces as you progress toward the first-world boss.
game.controls: Mouse, keyboard or gamepad; follow the in-game prompts.
game.tips:
Inspect your starting position before committing to exchanges.
Plan routes carefully because the path disappears behind you.
Use premoves when you can safely anticipate your next action.
game.features:
Complete first-world demo
Nested chessboard map and battles
30-second battle clock with move bonuses
Piece recruitment and upgrades
Browser save on the current device
game.short_description: Fight timed chess battles inside a crumbling chessboard map.

game.title: Cycle of the First Dawn
game.description:
Cycle of the First Dawn is a deliberately slow cultivation incremental built to run unattended for stretches of time. Work, training and exploration reveal opportunities gradually, while death and reincarnation carry parts of your development into later lives.

There is no required build: you can pursue mastery, experiment or let your character develop more broadly. The game is in active beta, with content and balance still changing. Export and import tools let you keep a separate backup of your progress.
game.how_to_play: Start with available work and training, explore opportunities as they appear, and carry persistent progress into another life. Try different activities to uncover systems over repeated runs.
game.controls: See the original itch.io page for the developer's control notes.
game.tips:
Keep occasional exported saves while the game is in beta.
Experiment with work and training instead of assuming the opening activities show everything.

Work, training and exploration

game.title: Retromine
game.description:
Retromine is a mining deckbuilding roguelike where survival competes with long-term growth. Play cards to collect resources, then spend ore on cards and upgrades. Scorium helps you escape danger, creating a tradeoff between getting stronger and getting out alive.

Procedural expeditions, resource and tool cards, and utility effects encourage different combinations across runs. The pixel-art presentation is accompanied by synthwave music. The developer describes the game as challenging and offers browser troubleshooting notes on the source page.
game.how_to_play: Use your cards to mine resources while keeping an escape possible. Bring back ore to buy cards and improve the deck, then attempt deeper expeditions.
game.controls: See the original itch.io page for the developer's control notes.
game.tips:
Balance ore for upgrades against scorium needed to survive.
Look for cards that support a coherent resource strategy.
If the in-game blue-screen error occurs, the developer recommends disabling CRT, background motion and card motion in Options.

Mining deckbuilding

game.description:
Nekodamashi pits you against Beluga, a sharp-tongued black cat dealer. Pick the higher of two face-down cards, and secretly scratch identifying marks while the dealer looks away. Being caught cheating gets you banned.

The game offers Easy and Hard difficulties, hints from Mister X after losses, and unlockable conversations. English, Japanese and Korean are supported. Content note: mild suggestive humor, including a spanking minigame after wins.

game.description:
USB: Plug It In Right turns plugging in a connector into an arcade challenge. A USB moves across an office desk toward computer ports. Match the orientation correctly and the PC explodes; get it wrong and the USB breaks.

Objects can briefly hide a port, making observation part of the timing challenge. The interface automatically selects English or Japanese using the browser language.

Desktop — Space, flip button, or drag left/right
Mobile — swipe left/right or tap the flip button
game.tips:
Check the port orientation before an obstruction covers it.
Avoid an unnecessary last-second flip when the connector already matches.

Two connector orientations

Temporary visual obstructions
Keyboard, mouse and touch options
English and Japanese
